push.title: Push notifications
push.state.on: Push notifications are on for this device.
push.state.off: Push notifications are off for this device.
push.state.granted: Notification permission is already allowed. One more tap finishes setting up this device.
push.granted_help: Tap Enable. You will not be asked for permission again.
push.state.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser.
push.denied_help: Open your browser's site settings, set Notifications to Allow, then come back here. This page updates by itself.
push.state.unsupported: This browser doesn't support push notifications. Messages and the Notice Box still work.
push.state.ios_install: Push notifications on iPhone and iPad need the app on your Home Screen.
push.ios_install_help: Needs iOS 16.4 or newer. In Safari tap Share, choose Add to Home Screen, then open Goppo from the Home Screen and return to Settings.
push.state.server_not_configured: Push notifications aren't set up on this server yet, so they can't be turned on. Messages and the Notice Box work normally.
push.server_not_configured_help: This is a server setting, not a problem with your phone or browser. The site owner has to finish it.
push.admin_fix: Admin: fix in .env, then reload the web app (run: flask push-status). Details: {details}
push.state.sw_failed: The background service that delivers notifications could not start.
push.sw_failed_help: Reload the page. If it keeps happening, clear this site's data in the browser or try another browser.
push.state.config_unavailable: Couldn't check the notification setup. Check your connection and try again.
push.err.dismissed: No permission was given, so notifications are still off.
push.err.subscribe_failed: This browser couldn't register for push. Make sure you are online and the browser's push service is available, then try again.
push.err.save_failed: Your device registered, but the server couldn't save it. Please try again.
push.err.server_not_configured: Push notifications aren't set up on this server yet.
push.err.session: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
push.err.forbidden: The security check failed. Reload the page and try again.
push.err.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
push.err.server_error: The server hit an error while saving this device. The site owner can see the details in the server error log.
